pileSamplingScope: All-active 2D clusters remain diagnostics. The unchanged <=3 pile limit applies to active non-airborne, non-recovering colliders. Counts are sampled twice per second; persistence is the span of consecutive positive samples for a stable slot/generation, not continuous observation.
performanceScope: Overall frame statistics include the late wait; per-stage traversal timing excludes deliberate pauses.
driver: Windows Player QAMove/QADash/QABrace input driver. Menu/pause/restart use public UI actions. No teleport, time override, scene skip, OS keyboard automation or human playtest.
